answer: Rule: every epoch each identity must pass a live 60-second interactive challenge, alone and in real time. One operator can only answer one challenge at a time, so a farm of N fakes needs N operators working at once: one operator-hour per fake per epoch, a linear cost that never batches. No velvet shortcut: a miss drops the identity off the ledge for the epoch and forfeits its reward. No identity is an island of excuses: every check is scored against that identity's own work history.
